clips.title: The story
paras: Tsunaman is a sentient water elemental stationed at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Acting as an agent of the Tribunal of the Tides, he watches over the elemental currents of Kalimdor and rallies Horde adventurers to confront corrupting forces.

Dwelling near the path leading from Sun Rock Retreat down into the Charred Vale, Tsunaman serves the Tribunal of the Tides, high-ranking servants aligned with the Tidehunter, Neptulon. Rather than showing mindless hostility to mortal travelers, he cooperates with the Horde to monitor elemental unrest throughout Kalimdor, particularly the disturbances rippling out of the submerged caverns of Blackfathom Deeps.

True to his elemental nature, Tsunaman harbors an instinctive, visceral hatred for fire in all forms. He constantly fumes over the nearby burning landscapes of the Charred Vale and elemental fire incursions. In camp, his animosity is so petty and unyielding that he regularly marches over to nearby cooking fires and campfires just to smack them out with a heavy fist of water.
